sections.text:
Before you listen to Hanroro's 'Ibchun,'
you need to know the image behind it.

A tiny sprout pushing through hard asphalt.
That fragile image is where the song begins.

So the spring in this song
isn't just a warm season.
It's proof that something survived.

To me, barely lifting my head,
it offers the first greeting of spring.

Knowing that, 'Ibchun' feels less like spring arriving,
and more like someone quietly choosing to bloom.
